default_exit._why: one exit for every family so rules compete on the same footing; the owner will decide the demo stop/take-profit later and this block changes then (a change = a new screen run, its variants counted again)
default_exit._fills: signal at the close of bar t; market order at the open of the 1-minute bar that starts at t's close (+ slippage); every 1-minute bar from the entry minute on: stop first (fills at the stop or the gap open, - slippage), then the target (a limit: needs a trade 1 tick through, fills at the target); time exit at the open of the first minute at or after entry + max_hold_min; flat at the session's flatten time; one position at a time; at most max_entries_per_session entries per session

E-508.title: First box break of each clock hour fade
E-508.hypothesis: The first close beyond the recent range inside a clock hour is the probe of hourly-rebalancing flow against a thin book; later breaks in the hour carry more information, the first is faded by liquidity providers.

E-509.title: Prior-day-candle-aligned dip/rip fade
E-509.hypothesis: After a prior session that closed clearly up (down), a close below (above) the recent range is a dip (rip) against yesterday's carried positioning; swing holders buy (sell) it back.

E-510.title: Round-number micro-break fade
E-510.hypothesis: Closes that break the recent range right at a round index number run into resting limit orders and option-strike hedging at that number, so the break is faded.

E-511.title: Prior-profile air-pocket follow
E-511.hypothesis: Price entering a price bin that traded little yesterday (low-volume node inside yesterday's range) meets little resting liquidity, so the move through it accelerates; follow the entry direction.

E-512.title: Spike-away-from-the-mass break fade
E-512.hypothesis: When most closes of the window sit at the opposite end of the box from the break, the break is a spike by few orders, not a drift of the crowd; the mass pulls price back.

E-513.title: Day-after-choppy-path break fade
E-513.hypothesis: After a session whose path efficiency was lower than its recent norm (much travel, little net move), participants keep rotating; breaks of short ranges are faded the next day.
